import json, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from harness import ktest, obj, run

# two entries with identical input values never merge
types = [{"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
         {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 2},
         {"name": "St", "kind": "enum", "values": ["s0", "s1"]}]
modules = [
  {"name": "a", "params": [["n", "U8"], ["s", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None},
  {"name": "b", "params": [["n", "U8"], ["s", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None},
]
def mk(entry, n, s, r):
    objs = [obj("x0", n, 1), obj("x2", ord(s[0]), 1), obj("x3", ord(s[1]) if len(s) > 1 else 0, 1),
            obj("x4", r, 1)]
    return {"entry": entry, "ktest": ktest(objs)}
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["a", "b"],
       "machine": None,
       "runs": [mk("a", 1, "hi", 0), mk("b", 1, "hi", 0), mk("a", 1, "hi", 5)]}
g = run(doc)
print(json.dumps(g["records"]), json.dumps(g["corpus"]))
assert [r["status"] for r in g["records"]] == ["READY", "READY", "DUPLICATE"]
assert len(g["corpus"]) == 2 and g["corpus"][0]["entry"] == "a" and g["corpus"][1]["entry"] == "b"
assert g["records"][2]["case"] == 0
print("PASS different entries never merge")

# stateful: two entries, machine shared, witnesses per corpus
machine = {"states": ["s0", "s1"], "initial": "s0", "state_param": "st", "message_param": "msg",
           "transitions": [{"from": "s0", "to": "s1", "command": "go", "cost": 3, "when": None}]}
modules = [
  {"name": "a", "params": [["st", "St"], ["msg", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None},
  {"name": "b", "params": [["st", "St"], ["msg", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None},
]
def mk2(entry, st, msg, r):
    objs = [obj("x0", st, 4), obj("x2", ord(msg[0]), 1), obj("x3", 0, 1), obj("x4", r, 1)]
    return {"entry": entry, "ktest": ktest(objs)}
doc = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["a", "b"],
       "machine": machine,
       "runs": [mk2("a", 1, "hi", 0), mk2("b", 1, "hi", 0), mk2("a", 1, "xy", 0), mk2("a", 0, "zz", 0)]}
g = run(doc)
print(json.dumps(g["corpus"], indent=None))
assert [c["commands"] for c in g["corpus"]] == [["go", "hi"], ["go", "hi"], ["go", "xy"], ["zz"]]
assert [c["cost"] for c in g["corpus"]] == [3, 3, 3, 0]
print("PASS shared machine across entries")

# enum with many values, string maxsize 512
big_enum = {"name": "Big", "kind": "enum", "values": ["v%04d" % i for i in range(4096)]}
types2 = [big_enum, {"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 512},
          {"name": "U8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8}]
modules2 = [{"name": "m", "params": [["e", "Big"], ["s", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "U8"], "requires": None}]
doc2 = {"types": types2, "modules": modules2, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
g2 = run(doc2)
print(g2["plans"][0]["variables"], len(g2["plans"][0]["slots"]))
assert g2["plans"][0]["variables"] == 1 + 1 + 512 + 1
objs = [obj("x0", 4095, 4)] + [obj("x%d" % (2 + i), 0x41 + (i % 26), 1) for i in range(512)] + [obj("x514", 7, 1)]
doc2["runs"] = [{"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest(objs)}]
g2 = run(doc2)
value = g2["corpus"][0]["inputs"]
print("enum", value["e"], "len(s)", len(value["s"]))
assert value["e"] == "v4095" and len(value["s"]) == 512
assert g2["records"][0]["model_result"] == 7
print("PASS 4096 enum values and maxsize 512")

# char values including NUL and 255
types3 = [{"name": "C", "kind": "char"}, {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "C", "size": 3}]
modules3 = [{"name": "m", "params": [["cs", "Arr"]], "result": ["r", "C"], "requires": None}]
doc3 = {"types": types3, "modules": modules3, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"], "machine": None,
        "runs": [{"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest([obj("x2", 0, 1), obj("x3", 255, 1), obj("x4", 65, 1), obj("x5", 0, 1)])}]}
g3 = run(doc3)
print(json.dumps(g3["corpus"]))
assert g3["corpus"][0]["inputs"]["cs"] == ["\x00", "ÿ", "A"]
assert g3["records"][0]["model_result"] == "\x00"
print("PASS char code points")

# escaped pattern metacharacters
types4 = [{"name": "Str", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4}]
mods4 = [{"name": "m", "params": [["s", "Str"]], "result": ["r", "Str"],
          "requires": ["match", ["var", "s"], r"\[\]\(\)\|\*\\"]}]
doc4 = {"types": types4, "modules": mods4, "calls": [], "pipes": [], "entries": ["m"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
def mk4(s):
    objs = [obj("x%d" % (1 + i), ord(s[i]) if i < len(s) else 0, 1) for i in range(4)]
    for i in range(len(s), 4):
        pass
    objs += [obj("x5", 0, 1)] + [obj("x%d" % (6 + i), 0, 1) for i in range(4)]
    return {"entry": "m", "ktest": ktest(objs)}
doc4["runs"] = [mk4("[]()|"), mk4("[]()")]
g4 = run(doc4)
print([r["status"] for r in g4["records"]])
assert g4["records"][0]["status"] == "FILTERED"   # 6 chars needed, 5 given
